# Playzoni

> Playzoni is a free online games website. Play hundreds of browser games instantly on phone, tablet or computer, with no download and no sign-up.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://playzoni.com/): popular and featured games
- [All categories](https://playzoni.com/categories): every game category
- [New games](https://playzoni.com/new-games): the latest games added
- [Popular games](https://playzoni.com/popular-games): the most played games
- [All games A to Z](https://playzoni.com/all-games): every game in one list
- [About Playzoni](https://playzoni.com/about): who we are
